using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Garnet.cluster;
using Garnet.client;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class FailoverSessionTests
    {
        // We test the BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync method indirectly by subclassing FailoverSession
        // and exposing the method as public for testing. We mock dependencies to trigger the LogCritical call.

        private class TestFailoverSession : FailoverSession
        {
            public TestFailoverSession(
                Mock<ILogger> loggerMock,
                Mock<GarnetClient> clientMock,
                string replicaId,
                byte[] configByteArray,
                bool throwInInnerTry)
            {
                this.logger = loggerMock.Object;
                this.primaryClient = clientMock.Object;
                this.testReplicaId = replicaId;
                this.testConfigByteArray = configByteArray;
                this.throwInInnerTry = throwInInnerTry;

                // Setup minimal clusterProvider and oldConfig mocks to satisfy method dependencies
                var clusterManagerMock = new Mock<IClusterManager>();
                clusterManagerMock.Setup(cm => cm.CurrentConfig).Returns(new ClusterConfigStub());

                var clusterProviderMock = new Mock<IClusterProvider>();
                clusterProviderMock.Setup(cp => cp.clusterManager).Returns(clusterManagerMock.Object);

                this.clusterProvider = clusterProviderMock.Object;

                this.failoverTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);
                this.cts = new CancellationTokenSource();

                // Setup client mock to simulate GossipAsync returning a disposable with Span property
                clientMock.Setup(c => c.GossipAsync(It.IsAny<byte[]>()))
                    .Returns(() =>
                    {
                        if (throwInInnerTry)
                        {
                            // Return a disposable that throws on ToArray to simulate exception in inner try
                            return Task.FromResult<IDisposableSpan>(new DisposableSpanThrowing());
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            return Task.FromResult<IDisposableSpan>(new DisposableSpanStub());
                        }
                    });

                // Setup ReplicaOf to return "OK"
                clientMock.Setup(c => c.ReplicaOf(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<int>()))
                    .ReturnsAsync("OK");
            }

            public ILogger logger;
            public GarnetClient primaryClient;
            public IClusterProvider clusterProvider;
            public TimeSpan failoverTimeout;
            public CancellationTokenSource cts;

            private string testReplicaId;
            private byte[] testConfigByteArray;
            private bool throwInInnerTry;

            // Expose the private method as public for testing
            public async Task CallBroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync()
            {
                await BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync(testReplicaId, testConfigByteArray);
            }

            // Stub classes to satisfy dependencies
            private class ClusterConfigStub : ClusterConfig
            {
                public override string LocalNodeId => "localNodeId";
                public override string LocalNodePrimaryId => "primaryId";
                public override string LocalNodeIp => "127.0.0.1";
                public override int LocalNodePort => 1234;
                public override bool IsKnown(string nodeId) => true;
            }

            private class DisposableSpanStub : IDisposableSpan
            {
                public ReadOnlySpan<byte> Span => new byte[] { 1, 2, 3 };
                public void Dispose() { }
            }

            private class DisposableSpanThrowing : IDisposableSpan
            {
                public ReadOnlySpan<byte> Span => throw new Exception("Simulated exception");
                public void Dispose() { }
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task BroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync_LogsCriticalOnException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var clientMock = new Mock<GarnetClient>(MockBehavior.Strict, null, null, 0, 0, null, null, 0, null);
            var replicaId = "replica1";
            var configByteArray = new byte[] { 0x01, 0x02 };

            var session = new TestFailoverSession(loggerMock, clientMock, replicaId, configByteArray, throwInInnerTry: true);

            // Act
            await session.CallBroadcastConfigAndRequestAttachAsync();

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Critical,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("IssueAttachReplicas faulted")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }

    // Interfaces and base classes to satisfy compilation for test stubs
    public interface IDisposableSpan : IDisposable
    {
        ReadOnlySpan<byte> Span { get; }
    }

    public abstract class ClusterConfig
    {
        public abstract string LocalNodeId { get; }
        public abstract string LocalNodePrimaryId { get; }
        public abstract string LocalNodeIp { get; }
        public abstract int LocalNodePort { get; }
        public abstract bool IsKnown(string nodeId);
    }

    public interface IClusterManager
    {
        ClusterConfig CurrentConfig { get; }
        bool TryTakeOverForPrimary();
        void gossipStats_UpdateGossipBytesRecv(int bytes);
        bool TryMerge(ClusterConfig config);
    }

    public interface IClusterProvider
    {
        IClusterManager clusterManager { get; }
    }

    public class GarnetClient : IDisposable
    {
        public GarnetClient(object endpoint, object tlsOptions, int sendPageSize, int maxOutstandingTasks, string authUsername, string authPassword, int epoch, ILogger logger) { }
        public virtual bool IsConnected => true;
        public virtual Task ReconnectAsync() => Task.CompletedTask;
        public virtual Task<IDisposableSpan> GossipAsync(byte[] config) => Task.FromResult<IDisposableSpan>(null);
        public virtual Task<string> ReplicaOf(string ip, int port) => Task.FromResult("OK");
        public virtual Task<long> FailStopWritesAsync(byte[] localIdBytes) => Task.FromResult(0L);
        public void Dispose() { }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Garnet.client;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.Tests
{
    public class ReplicaFailoverSessionLoggerExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogCritical_ExtensionMethod_LogsCriticalWithExceptionAndMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var exception = new InvalidOperationException("Test exception");
            var message = "IssueAttachReplicas faulted";

            // Act
            Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.LoggerExtensions.LogCritical(loggerMock.Object, exception, message);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Critical,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains(message)),
                    exception,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
